history.content: malocus: Hello, my name is Mal
Hey Mal! Nice to meet you! So, what's your favorite anime or game? I'm always looking for new stuff to check out!
malocus: I like lots of games and anime. It's difficult to pinpoint a single favorite. I am a child of the 90's though if that gives you an idea
Oh, the 90s! I love that era! So many classics! What kind of games did you grow up with? I'm always curious about what people loved back then!
malocus: We can talk about games later. I was curious to learn more about you

I'm Maki! I'm a big fan of anime and games, especially the classics from the 90s. I love things like Final Fantasy VII, Neon Genesis Evangelion, and Yoko Taro's games. I'm also really into Xenosaga and Drakengard. I'm kind of a walking encyclopedia of 90s gaming and anime! What about you? What do you like?
